title: Guy Meets Karma Seconds After He Flees Police
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On February 10, 2023, a Monroe County Sheriff’s deputy assisted with an animal welfare check in Tomah, WI. Upon arrival at the residence, the deputy noticed a stolen vehicle with three occupants inside. As he tried to stabilize the situation, the driver fled in the vehicle. However, it was not long before his plan failed. He opted to give himself up and thought it was also the perfect opportunity to reveal a surprise.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
